notes: Pinned by scripts/bootstrap.{ps1,sh}; both scripts verify sha256 after download and refuse to install a mismatch.
JRE: Eclipse Temurin JRE 25 (hotspot, x64). Freerouting 2.4.1 needs Java 25 (class file 69) - docs/research/04-autorouting.md, docs/VERIFICATION.md claim 8.
jre.<os>.url/sha256/size were taken verbatim from https://api.adoptium.net/v3/assets/latest/25/hotspot?image_type=jre&os=<os>&architecture=x64 on pinned_on.
freerouting.sha256 is the GitHub release asset digest and equals the sha256 of the jar the spikes ran (spikes/autorouting, spikes/freerouting-verify).
Engines are GPL-3.0 and are downloaded into the user's storage home at bootstrap time, never redistributed with kiwrap (docs/ARCHITECTURE.md section 12).
